Embedding request via Ollama local provider with all-minilm model

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	request := pkg.EmbeddingRequest{
		Model: `ollama/all-minilm`,
		Input: pkg.EmbeddingInput(`The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog`),
	}
		client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.Embed(request)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
